apiProbe.guestWithoutStoredOwner: returns an empty task collection rather than fabricated examples

backendListContract.ownerIsolation: authenticated user or exact simulator.guestId owner

statusGroups.unknown: remains visible under 全部 with a neutral status; it is never promoted to completed

trustRules: The target's 2 queued, 1 running, 1 failed and 3 completed overview counts are placeholders and never runtime facts.
The target's five task names, scenario tags, Patch 占位, source labels, descriptions, --:-- timestamps and feedback messages are placeholders and never runtime facts.
The live guest probe returning zero tasks is a valid empty state. A transport fallback, missing owner or failed request must not manufacture target task rows.
Only simulator.tasks records owned by the current authenticated user or exact simulator.guestId may populate task rows, counts, recent-record text and status filters.

The typed API rejects a task collection when any row lacks a non-empty taskId/status or contains malformed recommendations, request, analysis or report-summary fields; it falls back to blocked rather than passing partial transport data to the route.
Task title prefers a returned simcReportSummary.title, then a bounded returned question, then a deterministic mode label. It never infers a class, specialization, scenario, patch or source.
Task description, tags, statusText, build and scenario labels may use only returned simcReportSummary fields. Missing fields retain neutral unavailable positions rather than target placeholder copy.
Task status labels are deterministic Chinese display mappings of the returned status. Unknown states remain unknown and cannot be counted as success.
Dates are formatted only from returned createdAt or updatedAt. Invalid or missing dates display 未返回时间, never --:-- as if it were a real timestamp.

The target simultaneously demonstrates loading, populated and empty compositions. Runtime mounts all eight regions but each region renders the current truth: loading skeletons while fetching, real rows when present, and empty guidance when none exist.

When real rows exist, the empty_state region becomes app-authored task-flow guidance and cannot claim 暂无任务记录. When no rows exist, the same region may use the target's empty heading and three deterministic navigation steps.
The task_list region shows up to five rows at once and uses internal scrolling for the backend's maximum 50 records so page geometry remains stable.
Refresh-on-resume and manual refresh reuse simulator.tasks. A failed refresh preserves no unverified replacement collection and exposes retry in loading_state.
No ProductTabBar is mounted because tasks_list is a pushed route. Bottom actions navigate to the real SimC submit and current workbench routes.

mappings.runtime: AppShell pushed-route surface and PageFrame tasks-list variant
real back navigation and fixed route title 模拟任务台
derived counts for queued, running, failed and completed plus the latest real record
loading, synchronized, empty or transport-error status in one stable panel with manual retry
local 全部/排队/运行中/失败/已完成 filters and deterministic sort order control
internally scrollable real owner-scoped tasks with five stable visible positions and neutral unavailable fillers
empty-task guidance or non-claiming task-flow guidance using the same three-step composition
real navigation to SimC submit and current specialization workbench

stateContract.initial_loading: mount all eight regions, keep summary/filter/list/guidance geometry, show five task skeleton positions and the target-owned synchronization state
stateContract.ready_empty: derive zero counts, keep five neutral unavailable list positions, show the no-record heading and three navigation steps
stateContract.ready_populated: derive counts and latest record from returned tasks, populate an internally scrollable list and use non-claiming task-flow guidance
stateContract.filtered_empty: retain fetched collection and stable geometry, state that the current local filter has no matching tasks, and expose reset without claiming the account has no tasks
stateContract.error: retain all regions, show transport error and retry in loading_state, keep task positions unavailable, and do not mount RouteStatePanel
stateContract.resume_refresh: reload the same owner-scoped endpoint on subsequent useDidShow without duplicating rows or changing page geometry
